runtime.unit:
# /etc/systemd/system/change-guard.service
[Unit]
Description=k8s change guard (GitHub release gate)
Documentation=https://github.com/hey-mmm/k8s-change-guard
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target
ConditionPathIsReadWrite=/var/lib/change-guard

[Service]
Type=simple
User=change-guard
Group=change-guard
WorkingDirectory=/opt/change-guard/current
ExecStartPre=/usr/bin/test -x /opt/change-guard/current/k8s-change-guard
ExecStart=/opt/change-guard/current/k8s-change-guard daemon --config /etc/change-guard/config.yaml
EnvironmentFile=-/etc/change-guard/proxy.env
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=10
TimeoutStartSec=60
TimeoutStopSec=45
KillMode=mixed
SyslogIdentifier=change-guard
StandardOutput=journal
StandardError=journal

StateDirectory=change-guard
StateDirectoryMode=0700
UMask=0077
NoNewPrivileges=yes
CapabilityBoundingSet=
AmbientCapabilities=
PrivateTmp=yes
PrivateDevices=yes
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=yes
ProtectKernelTunables=yes
ProtectKernelModules=yes
ProtectKernelLogs=yes
ProtectControlGroups=yes
ProtectClock=yes
ProtectHostname=yes
ProtectProc=invisible
InaccessiblePaths=/root /home
ReadOnlyPaths=/etc/change-guard /opt/change-guard
ReadWritePaths=/var/lib/change-guard
RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_UNIX AF_INET AF_INET6 AF_NETLINK
# bubblewrap --unshare-all creates user, mount, network, PID, IPC, UTS and
# (when possible) cgroup namespaces.  RestrictNamespaces=~user ... (or a
# positive list that omits any of them) makes bwrap fail before Helm runs, so
# namespace creation must remain available to the unprivileged service user.
RestrictNamespaces=false
RestrictRealtime=yes
RestrictSUIDSGID=yes
LockPersonality=yes
MemoryDenyWriteExecute=yes
SystemCallArchitectures=native
# bubblewrap must be able to create user/mount/net/pid namespaces and mount a
# temporary root.  The general service filter remains in force.
SystemCallFilter=@system-service mount umount2 pivot_root unshare setns clone clone3 chroot setuid setgid
# Go-based helpers (helm/kubectl) reserve a large *virtual* address space and
# start several runtime threads.  Do not cap RLIMIT_AS and keep NPROC/Tasks
# high enough for Go; MemoryMax is a cgroup limit on resident memory, which does
# not count Go's unused virtual reservations.
LimitNOFILE=8192
LimitNPROC=8192
TasksMax=8192
LimitCORE=0
MemoryHigh=1536M
MemoryMax=2G

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
